question: What practice leads to coming to Krishna?
premises: One should fix mind on Krishna.
One should be devotee, worshipper, and bow.
Krishna promises that such a one comes to him.
inference: Devotional practice with mind fixed on Krishna leads to union with him.
uncertainties: Editorial phrases are fused with verse tokens.
plain_english: Be of mind fixed on me, be my devotee, worship me, bow to me; you will come to me alone.
